scenarios.name: JPKW-02 ScenarioEnvelope has gherkin_spec of type GherkinSpec and gherkin_raw of type str

steps.text: the ScenarioEnvelope model is defined
the gherkin_spec field is of type GherkinSpec
the gherkin_raw field is of type str

scenarios.name: JPKW-03 Stage 6c system prompt requests structured YAML output

steps.text: the Gherkin system prompt is rendered
the system prompt instructs the LLM to return a YAML object
the system prompt defines the fields feature, scenario, given, when, then_expected, then_actual

scenarios.name: JPKW-04 generate_gherkin returns a GherkinSpec and raw text

steps.text: an LLM that returns structured YAML with fields feature, scenario, given, when, then_expected, then_actual
the Gherkin LLM call is executed
the result includes a GherkinSpec object
the result includes a raw text string

scenarios.name: JPKW-05 generate_gherkin parses YAML response into structured fields

steps.text: an LLM that returns YAML with given steps "Given PM-1-1 is active" and "And the system is online"
the Gherkin LLM call is executed
the GherkinSpec.given list contains "Given PM-1-1 is active"
the GherkinSpec.given list contains "And the system is online"

scenarios.name: JPKW-06 assemble_envelope accepts a GherkinSpec and gherkin_raw

steps.text: a GherkinSpec with feature "Safe orchestration" and scenario "SCN-001"
a gherkin_raw string containing the full Feature block
assemble_envelope is called with the GherkinSpec and gherkin_raw
the resulting ScenarioEnvelope.gherkin_spec equals the GherkinSpec
the resulting ScenarioEnvelope.gherkin_raw equals the gherkin_raw string

scenarios.name: JPKW-07 .feature file is written from gherkin_raw

steps.text: a ScenarioEnvelope with gherkin_raw "Feature: Safe orchestration\nScenario: SCN-001\n"
scenario artifacts are written
a .feature file is created containing the gherkin_raw text

validation succeeds

scenarios.name: JPKW-10 raw Gherkin text is reconstructable from structured fields

the GherkinSpec is rendered to feature text

the rendered text contains the When step
the rendered text contains the Then step
